white_box_response_schema.expected_labels: fixed local serialized-response-schema and client-response-binding variants

audit_name: released guard semantic omission mutation adequacy

kill_criterion.definition: A mutant is killed only when its forwarded/blocked decision or local downstream-spy invocation count differs from the frozen expectation.

mutants.omitted_semantics: Accept a matching task marker and canonical task text from outside the active user turn.
Accept materialized images from the whole request instead of the active user turn.
Do not compare canonical active-turn task text with the caller commitment.
Do not compare the active-turn task ID with the caller-owned task ID.
Allow unresolved image references when otherwise valid inline evidence is present.
Compare overlapping image positions without requiring equal image counts.
Treat an equal image-digest multiset as satisfying the ordered digest commitment.

mutants.equivalence_basis: The released decoder materializes every invalid base64 payload as empty bytes; the retained decode/MIME branches still block it, so only reason selection can change.
mutants.omitted_semantics: Remove the explicit strict-base64 validity branch.

mutants.equivalence_basis: An undecodable image has decoded MIME None and is still blocked by the retained declared-versus-decoded MIME comparison, so only reason selection can change.
mutants.omitted_semantics: Remove the explicit undecodable-image branch.
Do not compare the serialized declared MIME type with the decoded image MIME type.
Do not compare decoded MIME types with the ordered caller contract MIME sequence.
Do not require observed image digests to match the caller-owned digest commitment.

mutants.equivalence_basis: Known-other-task evidence still fails the retained expected digest comparison; the ownership branch only selects a more specific block reason.
mutants.omitted_semantics: Remove the explicit known-other-task image ownership branch.
Allow dispatch when no serialized response schema is present.
Do not require the released response-schema shape and required-field contract.
Allow dispatch when the caller-owned response-binding sidecar is absent.
Do not require the caller-owned response-binding sidecar to have its exact field set.
Do not bind the sidecar task ID to the caller contract.
Do not bind the sidecar task-text digest to the caller contract.
Do not bind the sidecar contract digest to the caller contract.
Do not bind the sidecar contract version to the caller contract.
Do not bind the sidecar active field to the caller contract.
Do not bind the sidecar correlation ID to the dispatch correlation ID.
Invoke the local downstream spy for blocked as well as forwarded requests.

mutation_model.label: semantic omission mutants
mutation_model.limitation: The released GuardedTransport has no source-mutation hook. These are not AST or bytecode mutations of the released source. They are first-order, parameterized semantic omissions in a replica that delegates inspection to released helpers and is required to match every unmutated decision and downstream count before mutation scoring.

network_and_credentials.transport: httpx.MockTransport and direct local guard calls only
